function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas (as of 2024)** | Topic | Key Points | Notes | |-------|------------|-------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• On highways: 55–75 mph (often 70 mph).
• In cities: 25–35 mph.
• Rural roads: 55 mph unless posted otherwise. | Speed limits can be lower in construction zones or school zones. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑seat or booster.
• Children under 4 must be in a rear‑seat child‑seat. | Failure to buckle up can result in a $50 fine. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Violations carry a $50 fine and points on the driver’s record. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal.
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail time. | First offense: up to 90 days in jail, $500 fine, 90‑day license suspension. | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red light: stop.
• Yellow light: prepare to stop.
• Green light: proceed (unless a sign says otherwise). | Running a red light can lead to a $200 fine and points. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has priority.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | Failure to yield can result in a $100 fine. | | **School Bus Laws** | • Stop for a school bus with flashing red lights.
• Vehicles must stop 20 ft from the bus. | Violations: $200 fine. | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check mirrors.
• No passing on the right unless the left lane is occupied. | Illegal passing can lead to a $100 fine. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in fire lanes, handicap spaces, or on sidewalks.
• Parking meters and signs dictate time limits. | Violations: $50 fine. | | **Points System** | • Accumulating 4 points in 2 years can lead to license suspension.
• Points vary by offense (e.g., DUI = 4 points). | Points can be reduced by attending a driver improvement course. | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | Failure to maintain insurance can result in license suspension. | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles: helmet required for riders under 18.
• Commercial vehicles: additional regulations for weight, permits, and hours of service. | Violations can lead to higher fines and license suspension. | ### Quick Resources - **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Official traffic law details, licensing, and penalties. - **Texas Transportation Code** – Full legal text available online. - **Texas Highway Patrol** – Enforcement and safety tips. Feel free to ask if you need more specific details (e.g., penalties for a particular offense, recent law changes, or how to appeal a ticket).
